articles.title_en: Manufacturing Revolutions: Industrial Policy and Industrialization in South Korea
articles.title_cn: 制造业革命：韩国的产业政策和工业化
articles.abstract_en: I study the effect of industrial policies on industrial development by considering an important episode during the East Asian miracle: South Korea’s heavy and chemical industry (HCI) drive, 1973–1979. Based on newly assembled data, I use the introduction and termination of industrial policies to study their effects during and after the intervention period. I reveal that HCI policies promoted the expansion and dynamic comparative advantage of directly targeted industries. Using variation in exposure to policies through the input-output network, I demonstrate that the policy indirectly benefited downstream users of targeted intermediates. The benefits of HCI persisted even after the policy ended, and some results took time to materialize. The findings suggest that the temporary drive shifted Korean manufacturing into more advanced markets and supported durable change. This study helps clarify the lessons drawn from the East Asian growth miracle.
articles.abstract_cn: 我通过考虑东亚奇迹期间的一个重要事件来研究产业政策对产业发展的影响：韩国的重化工业（HCI）驱动，1973-1979。根据新收集的数据，我利用产业政策的出台和终止来研究其干预期间和之后的影响。我发现，人机交互政策促进了直接目标产业的扩张和动态比较优势。通过输入输出网络利用政策暴露的变化，我证明该政策间接使目标中间体的下游用户受益。即使在政策结束后，HCI 的好处仍然存在，而且一些结果需要时间才能实现。研究结果表明，暂时的推动力将韩国制造业转移到了更先进的市场，并支持了持久的变革。这项研究有助于阐明东亚增长奇迹的教训。

articles.title_cn: 系统性歧视：理论与测量
articles.abstract_en: Economists often measure discrimination as disparities arising from the direct effects of group identity. We develop new tools to model and measure systemic discrimination, capturing how discrimination in other decisions indirectly contributes to disparities. A novel experimental design, the iterated audit, identifies systemic discrimination. We illustrate these new tools in two field experiments. The first experiment shows how racial discrimination can accumulate across multiple rounds of hiring through the interaction of two forces: greater discrimination against inexperienced workers, which affects the opportunity to obtain experience, and high subsequent returns to experience. The second experiment shows how gender-based differences in the language of recommendation letters can translate into systemic gender discrimination in STEM hiring. We discuss how our findings qualify previous results on direct discrimination and how our tools can be used to target policy interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家经常将歧视衡量为群体身份直接影响所产生的差异。我们开发新工具来建模和衡量系统性歧视，捕捉其他决策中的歧视如何间接造成差异。一种新颖的实验设计，即迭代审核，识别了系统性歧视。我们在二现场实验中说明了这些新工具。 第一实验表明种族歧视如何通过二力量的相互作用在多轮招聘中累积：对缺乏经验的工人的更大歧视，影响获得经验的机会以及随后的高经验回报。 第二 实验表明，推荐信语言中基于性别的差异如何转化为 STEM 招聘中的系统性性别歧视。我们讨论我们的研究结果如何验证先前关于直接歧视的结果，以及如何使用我们的工具来针对政策干预。

articles.title_en: Structural Estimation Under Misspecification: Theory and Implications for Practice
articles.title_cn: 错误指定下的结构估计：理论和实践意义
articles.abstract_en: A researcher can use a tightly parameterized structural model to obtain internally consistent estimates of a wide range of economically interesting targets. We ask how reliable these estimates are when the researcher’s model may be misspecified. We focus on the case of multivariate, potentially nonlinear models where the causal variable of interest is endogenous. Reliable estimates require that the researcher’s model is flexible enough to describe the effects of the endogenous variable approximately correctly. Reliable estimates do not require that the researcher has correctly specified the role of the exogenous controls in the model. However, if the role of the controls is misspecified, reliable estimates require a property we call strong exclusion. Strong exclusion depends on having sufficiently many instruments that are unrelated to the controls. We discuss how practitioners can achieve strong exclusion, and illustrate our findings with an application to a differentiated goods model of demand for beer.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究人员可以使用严格参数化的结构模型来获得对各种经济上感兴趣的目标的内部一致的估计。我们询问当研究人员的模型可能被错误指定时，这些估计的可靠性如何。我们关注多元、潜在非线性模型的情况，其中感兴趣的因果变量是内生的。可靠的估计要求研究人员的模型足够灵活，能够大致正确地描述内生变量的影响。可靠的估计不需要研究人员正确指定模型中外生控制的作用。然而，如果控制的作用被错误指定，可靠的估计需要我们称为强排除的属性。强排除依赖于拥有足够多与控制无关的工具。我们讨论从业者如何实现强排除，并通过应用于啤酒需求的差异化商品模型来说明我们的发现。

articles.title_en: The Race Between Education, Technology, and the Minimum Wage
articles.title_cn: 教育、技术和最低工资之间的竞赛
articles.abstract_en: What is the effect of the real minimum wage on wages and inequality? I develop a theory that nests the race between education and technology. The theory predicts that the effect of changes in minimum wages is initially small but grows over time. I present empirical evidence of these dynamic effects: the elasticity of real wages grows substantially over a three-year period. I show that minimum wages help rationalize a considerable decline in real wages of low-education workers in the 1980s and play a role in shaping the evolution of the U.S. college premium.
articles.abstract_cn: 实际最低工资对工资和不平等有何影响？我发展了一种理论，将教育与技术之间的竞争联系起来。该理论预测，最低工资变化的影响最初很小，但随着时间的推移而增加。我提供了这些动态效应的经验证据：实际工资的弹性在三年期间大幅增长。我表明，最低工资有助于使1980低学历工人实际工资大幅下降合理化，并在塑造美国大学溢价的演变中发挥作用。

articles.title_en: Voluntary Minimum Wages: The Local Labor Market Effects of National Retailer Policies
articles.title_cn: 自愿最低工资：国家零售商政策对当地劳动力市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: Low unionization rates, a falling real federal minimum wage, and outsourcing have hampered wage growth in the low-wage sector in the United States for several decades. In recent years (2014–2023), a number of large private retailers—including some of the largest employers in the United States—have opted to institute or raise company-wide, voluntary minimum wages (VMWs) for their employees. We use anonymized payroll data from a large credit bureau and a major payroll provider to study the effects of these national retailer policies on adopting employers’ own wages and employment as well as their spillovers to other employers in shared local labor markets, variously defined. Using stacked event studies centered around multiple VMW events and a continuous treatment variable defined as the gap between local-area wages and the company minimum, we find that VMWs result in sizable wage increases and reductions in turnover at the companies that implement them. Turning to wages at other companies, we estimate small, often economically negligible, spillover effects across multiple measures of exposure to VMWs and numerous definitions of relevant competitors, including firms connected by worker flows. Together, the evidence points to little role for strategic interactions in the transmission of large retailers’ wage policies to other firms. Voluntary minimum wage policies have affected over 3 million jobs at adopting employers, yet their impact on the broader labor market is limited.
articles.abstract_cn: 几十年来，低工会率、实际联邦最低工资下降以及外包阻碍了美国低工资行业的工资增长。近年来（2014-2023），许多大型私营零售商（包括美国一些最大的雇主）选择在全公司范围内为其员工制定或提高自愿最低工资（VMW）。我们使用来自大型信用局和主要薪资提供商的匿名薪资数据来研究这些国家零售商政策对采用雇主自己的工资和就业的影响，以及它们对共享当地劳动力市场中不同定义的其他雇主的溢出效应。使用以多个 VMW 事件为中心的堆叠事件研究以及定义为当地工资与公司最低工资之间差距的连续处理变量，我们发现 VMW 会导致实施 VMW 的公司大幅工资增加和营业额减少。谈到其他公司的工资，我们估计，在VMW暴露的多种衡量标准和相关竞争对手（包括通过工人流动连接的公司）的众多定义中，溢出效应很小，通常在经济上可以忽略不计。总之，证据表明，战略互动在将大型零售商的工资政策传递给其他公司方面几乎没有发挥作用。自愿最低工资政策影响了雇主的3百万个工作岗位，但对更广泛的劳动力市场的影响有限。

articles.title_en: A Monetary-Fiscal Theory of Sudden Inflations
articles.title_cn: 突发通货膨胀的货币财政理论
articles.abstract_en: This article posits an information channel as an explanation for sudden inflations. Households saving via nominal government bonds face a choice whether to acquire costly information about future government surpluses. They trade off the cost of acquiring information about the surpluses that back bond repayment against the benefit of a more informed saving decision. Through the information channel, small changes in the economic environment can trigger large responses in consumer behavior and prices. This setting explains why there can be long stretches of time during which government surpluses have large movements with little inflation response; then at some point, something snaps, and a sudden inflation takes off that is strongly responsive to incoming fiscal news.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个信息渠道来解释突然的通货膨胀。通过名义政府债券进行储蓄的家庭面临着是否获取有关未来政府盈余的昂贵信息的选择。他们权衡获取支持债券偿还的盈余信息的成本与更明智的储蓄决策的好处。通过信息渠道，经济环境的微小变化可以引发消费者行为和价格的大反应。这种背景解释了为什么政府盈余可能在很长一段时间内大幅波动，而通胀反应却很小。然后在某个时刻，某些事情突然爆发，通货膨胀突然爆发，并对即将到来的财政消息做出强烈反应。

articles.title_en: Micro MPCs and Macro Counterfactuals: The Case of the 2008 Rebates
articles.title_cn: 微观 MPC 和宏观反事实：2008 回扣案例
articles.abstract_en: We present evidence that the high estimated marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) from the leading household studies result in implausible macroeconomic counterfactuals. Using the 2008 tax rebate as a case study, we calibrate a standard macro model with the estimated micro MPCs to construct counterfactual macroeconomic consumption paths in the absence of a rebate. The counterfactual paths imply that consumption expenditures would have plummeted in spring and summer 2008 and mostly recovered in September 2008. We use narratives and forecasts to argue that these paths are implausible. We show that standard two-way fixed effect estimates of the micro MPCs are upward biased. When we correct for the biases, we estimate smaller micro MPCs using the CEX data than the previous literature. We show that realistic modifications of the model result in general equilibrium forces that dampen rather than amplify micro MPCs. The combination of smaller micro MPCs and dampening general equilibrium forces implies general equilibrium consumption multipliers that are below 0.2.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，主要家庭研究中估计的高边际消费倾向（MPC）导致了令人难以置信的宏观经济反事实。使用2008退税作为案例研究，我们用估计的微观MPC校准标准宏观模型，以在没有退税的情况下构建反事实的宏观经济消费路径。反事实路径意味着消费支出将在春季和夏季大幅下降2008，并在九月2008大部分恢复。我们用叙述和预测来论证这些路径是不可信的。我们表明，微型 MPC 的标准二方式固定效应估计存在向上偏差。当我们纠正偏差时，我们使用 CEX 数据估计比之前文献更小的微型 MPC。我们表明，模型的实际修改会产生一般平衡力，从而抑制而不是放大微型 MPC。较小的微观 MPC 和抑制一般平衡力的组合意味着一般均衡消耗乘数低于 0.2。

articles.title_en: Collective Bargaining for Women: How Unions Can Create Female-Friendly Jobs
articles.title_cn: 妇女集体谈判：工会如何创造女性友好的就业机会
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of unions in improving workplaces for women. Starting in 2015, Brazil’s largest trade union federation made women central to its agenda. Using a difference-in-differences design that leverages variation in union affiliation to this federation, we find that “bargaining for women” increased female-friendly amenities in collective bargaining agreements and in practice. These changes led women to queue for jobs at treated establishments and separate from them less—both revealed-preference measures of firm value. We find no evidence that gains came at the expense of wages, employment, or firm profits. Better amenities instead reduced turnover and absenteeism, suggesting greater worker satisfaction and effort. Larger improvements occurred where women initially composed a lower share of workers or union leaders. Our findings show that shifting union priorities toward women improved workplaces without meaningful trade-offs and benefited both workers and employers. They illustrate the potential for unions to improve workplace quality by focusing on the needs of less represented workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究工会在改善女性工作场所方面的作用。从2015开始，巴西最大的工会联合会将妇女作为其议程的核心。通过利用差异中的差异设计，利用工会隶属关系的差异，我们发现“为女性讨价还价”在集体谈判协议和实践中增加了对女性友好的便利条件。这些变化导致女性在受待遇的机构中排队等候工作，并减少与这些机构的分离——这都是衡量公司价值的显性偏好指标。我们没有发现任何证据表明收益是以牺牲工资、就业或公司利润为代价的。更好的便利设施反而减少了人员流动和缺勤，这表明员工满意度更高，工作更加努力。较大的改善出现在妇女最初在工人或工会领导人中所占比例较低的地方。我们的研究结果表明，将工会优先事项转向女性可以改善工作场所，而无需进行有意义的权衡，并使工人和雇主都受益。它们说明了工会通过关注代表性较少的工人的需求来提高工作场所质量的潜力。

articles.title_en: Revealed Beliefs and the Marriage Market Return to Education
articles.title_cn: 揭示的信仰和婚姻市场回归教育
articles.abstract_en: We develop a new methodology to estimate subjective beliefs from hypothetical-choice data. Our identification approach is based on the novel insight that by varying the amount of information on future realizations of stochastic variables, discrete-choice experiments can identify not only preferences but also subjective beliefs. We formally prove this result in a general setting and apply it to design a strategic survey instrument to measure Rajasthani parents’ subjective beliefs over the joint distribution of girls’ age of marriage, education, and marriage match quality. Our approach allows us to quantify the importance of perceived marriage market returns to education and youth, and perform various counterfactual simulation exercises. We find that eliminating the perceived marriage market return to education causes a 60% drop in the number of girls still in school at age 16, and almost none continue their education by age 18. Responses to our strategic survey instrument allow us accurately to predict realized schooling trajectories in follow-up data we collect from the same sample five years after our experimental data collection.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新的方法来根据假设选择数据估计主观信念。我们的识别方法基于一种新颖的见解，即通过改变随机变量未来实现的信息量，离散选择实验不仅可以识别偏好，还可以识别主观信念。我们在一般环境下正式证明了这一结果，并将其应用于设计一个战略调查工具，以衡量拉贾斯坦父母对女孩结婚年龄、教育程度和婚姻匹配质量联合分布的主观信念。我们的方法使我们能够量化感知婚姻市场回报对教育和青年的重要性，并进行各种反事实模拟练习。我们发现，消除婚姻市场对教育的回报会导致 60% 年龄仍在上学的女孩人数下降 16，并且几乎没有人在年龄 18 继续接受教育。对我们的战略调查工具的反应使我们能够在实验数据收集后五年从同一样本中收集的后续数据中准确预测已实现的学校教育轨迹。

articles.abstract_en: We study optimal nonlinear taxation of single and married households. Taxes on couples depend on the earnings of both spouses and are an example of multidimensional tax schedules. We develop novel analytical techniques to study properties of such taxes. We show that the optimal marginal taxes for married individuals are generally lower than for single individuals because resource sharing in couples provides socially valuable redistribution. Under realistic assumptions, the optimal tax rates for married individuals increase with the correlation of spousal earnings, the marginal tax rates for one spouse increase (decrease) in the earnings of the other if both spouses have low (high) earnings, and the primary earner faces lower marginal taxes than the secondary earner.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究单身和已婚家庭的最优非线性税收。夫妻的税收取决于配偶双方的收入，是多维税表的一个例子。我们开发新颖的分析技术来研究此类税收的属性。我们表明，已婚个人的最佳边际税收通常低于单身个人，因为夫妻之间的资源共享提供了具有社会价值的重新分配。在现实的假设下，已婚个人的最佳税率随着配偶收入的相关性而增加，如果配偶双方收入都低（高），则一配偶的边际税率会增加（减少）另一方的收入，并且主要收入者面临的边际税率低于第二收入者。

articles.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of America’s Largest Residential Racial Desegregation Program: Gautreaux
articles.title_cn: 美国最大的住宅种族废除种族隔离计划的长期影响：Gautreaux
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the effects of the largest residential racial desegregation initiative in U.S. history, the Gautreaux Assisted Housing Program. From the late 1970s to the 1990s, Gautreaux moved thousands of Black families into predominantly white neighborhoods to support racial and economic integration. We link historical program records to administrative data and use plausibly exogenous variation in neighborhood placements to study how desegregating moves affect children in the long run. Being placed in the predominantly white neighborhoods targeted by the program significantly increases children’s future lifetime earnings and wealth. These moves also increase the likelihood of marriage and particularly raise the probability of being married to a white spouse. Moreover, placements through Gautreaux affect neighborhood choices in adulthood. Those placed in predominantly white neighborhoods during childhood live in more racially diverse areas with higher rates of upward mobility nearly 40 years later.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国历史上最大的废除住宅种族隔离倡议——高特罗辅助住房计划的影响。从1970晚期到1990，高特罗将数千个黑人家庭搬进了以白人为主的社区，以支持种族和经济融合。我们将历史计划记录与行政数据联系起来，并利用社区安置中看似合理的外生变化来研究废除种族隔离的举措如何对儿童产生长期影响。安置在该计划针对的以白人为主的社区，可以显着增加儿童未来一生的收入和财富。这些举措也增加了结婚的可能性，特别是增加了与白人配偶结婚的可能性。此外，高特罗的安置会影响成年后的社区选择。那些在童年时期居住在以白人为主的社区的人生活在种族更加多元化的地区，近40年后，他们的向上流动率更高。

articles.title_en: Lives Versus Livelihoods: The Impact of the Great Recession on Mortality and Welfare
articles.title_cn: 生命与生计：大衰退对死亡率和福利的影响
articles.abstract_en: We leverage spatial variation in the severity of the Great Recession across the United States to examine its impact on mortality and explore the quantitative implications. We estimate that an increase in the unemployment rate of the magnitude of the Great Recession reduces the average annual age-adjusted mortality rate by 2.3%, with effects persisting for at least 10 years. Mortality reductions appear across causes of death and are concentrated in the half of the population with a high school degree or less. We estimate similar percentage reductions in mortality at all ages, with declines in elderly mortality thus responsible for about three-quarters of the total mortality reduction. Recession-induced mortality declines are driven primarily by external effects of reduced aggregate economic activity on mortality, and reduced air pollution appears to be a quantitatively important mechanism. Incorporating our estimates of procyclical mortality into a standard macroeconomic framework substantially reduces the welfare costs of recessions, particularly for people with less education, and at older ages.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国大衰退严重程度的空间变化来研究其对死亡率的影响并探讨其定量影响。我们估计，大衰退程度的失业率上升会使平均年龄调整死亡率降低2.3%，其影响至少持续10年。死亡率下降出现在各种死因中，并且集中在高中或以下学历的人口中。我们估计所有年龄段的死亡率都有类似的下降百分比，其中老年人死亡率的下降约占总死亡率下降的四分之一。经济衰退引起的死亡率下降主要是由总体经济活动减少对死亡率的外部影响推动的，而空气污染的减少似乎是一个重要的定量机制。将我们对顺周期死亡率的估计纳入标准宏观经济框架可以大大降低经济衰退的福利成本，特别是对于受教育程度较低和年龄较大的人来说。

articles.title_en: What Works and for Whom? Effectiveness and Efficiency of School Capital Investments Across the U.S.
articles.title_cn: 什么有效以及对谁有效？美国各地学校资本投资的有效性和效率
articles.abstract_en: This article identifies which investments in school facilities help students and which are valued by homeowners. Using novel data on school district bonds, test scores, and house prices across 29 U.S. states and a research design based on narrowly decided elections with staggered timing, we find that increased capital spending in schools significantly improves test scores and is efficient on average. However, the effects vary widely depending on the type of project and the characteristics of the school district. Investments in essential infrastructure, such as HVAC systems or pollutant removal, yield notable improvements in student performance, while expenditures on athletic facilities show no measurable academic benefit. Socioeconomically disadvantaged districts gain disproportionately from capital investments, even after accounting for project type, yet these districts typically underinvest in such projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文确定了学校设施的哪些投资对学生有帮助，哪些受到房主的重视。利用美国各州29学区债券、考试成绩和房价的新数据，以及基于交错时间的狭隘选举的研究设计，我们发现学校增加资本支出可以显着提高考试成绩，并且平均效率较高。然而，根据项目类型和学区的特点，效果差异很大。对暖通空调系统或污染物清除等重要基础设施的投资可以显着提高学生的成绩，而体育设施的支出却没有显示出可衡量的学术效益。即使考虑到项目类型，社会经济弱势地区从资本投资中获得的收益也不成比例，但这些地区通常对此类项目的投资不足。

articles.title_en: “Descended from Immigrants and Revolutionists”: How Family History Shapes Immigration Policy Making
articles.title_cn: “移民和革命者的后裔”：家族史如何影响移民政策的制定
articles.abstract_en: Does family history matter for policy making in democracies? Linking members of Congress (MCs) to the census, we observe countries of birth for members, their parents, and their grandparents, allowing us to measure ancestry for the politicians in office when U.S. immigration policy changed dramatically, from closing the border in the 1920s to reshaping admittance criteria in the 1960s. We find that legislators descended from immigrant parents or grandparents support more permissive immigration legislation. They are also less likely to speak negatively about immigration in speeches before Congress. A regression discontinuity design analyzing close elections, which addresses district-level selection and holds district composition constant, confirms our results on roll call voting and speech. Efforts to account for selection into immigration—such as comparing international immigrants to domestic migrants and exploiting variation in restrictive legislation targeting specific regions of origin—further confirm the relationship between family immigration experience and more permissive stances on immigration policy. We then explore mechanisms, finding support for in-group identity in connecting family history with policy making. MCs name their children in ways that express immigrant identity, and immigrant-descended MCs discuss immigration using more personal frames, emphasizing family over economic considerations. Our findings illustrate the important role of personal background in legislative behavior in democratic societies, even on major and controversial topics like immigration, and suggest how experiences transmitted from previous generations can inform lawmakers’ views.
articles.abstract_cn: 家族史对民主国家的政策制定重要吗？将国会议员 (MC) 与人口普查联系起来，我们观察议员、他们的父母和祖父母的出生国，使我们能够在美国移民政策发生巨大变化（从 1920 关闭边境到 1960 重塑准入标准）时衡量在任政客的血统。我们发现，移民父母或祖父母的后裔立法者支持更宽松的移民立法。他们也不太可能在国会演讲中对移民发表负面言论。分析势均力敌的选举的回归不连续性设计解决了区级选举问题并保持区组成不变，证实了我们在点名投票和演讲方面的结果。考虑移民选择的努力——例如将国际移民与国内移民进行比较，以及利用针对特定原籍地区的限制性立法的变化——进一步证实了家庭移民经历与更宽松的移民政策立场之间的关系。然后，我们探索机制，寻找对群体内认同的支持，将家族史与政策制定联系起来。主持人以表达移民身份的方式给孩子命名，而移民后裔的主持人则使用更多的个人框架来讨论移民问题，强调家庭而不是经济考虑。我们的研究结果说明了个人背景在民主社会立法行为中的重要作用，甚至在移民等重大且有争议的话题上也是如此，并表明前几代人传承的经验如何影响立法者的观点。

articles.title_en: The Evolutionary Stability of Moral Foundations
articles.abstract_en: Moral foundations theory is an influential empirical description of moral perception. According to this theory, individuals make moral judgments based on five distinct “moral foundations”: care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and sanctity. We provide a theory that explores the claimed evolutionary basis for these moral foundations. The theory conceptualizes these five moral foundations as specific modifications of fitness payoffs in a 2 × 2 game. We find that the five foundations are distinguishable from each other and evolutionarily stable. However, they are not a minimal set: strict subsets of the foundations suffice to describe all preferences that are evolutionarily stable. Not all evolutionarily stable foundations deliver social fitness improvement over the Nash equilibrium in the fitness game: we characterize which do. Finally, we study moral overdrive, that is, the situation in which the moral component of preferences totally dominates fitness payoffs and drives decision making entirely. While every one of the five foundations is compatible with moral overdrive in at least one fitness game, there is no fitness game in which moral overdrive is compatible with social fitness improvement. These results are partially extended to n × n games. We derive two testable implications from the theory and find empirical support for them.
